answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust anchor for Sybil resistance in multi-agent systems, requiring agents to commit capital to validate transitions. This acts as an oasis for honest participation, as attackers must incur massive financial costs to acquire enough influence to subvert the chain. Like a digital lantern, this economic weighting illuminates malicious intent, making the cost of spinning up numerous fake identities prohibitively expensive compared to the potential rewards of a failed attack.
